name: Shahed-136 loitering munition
armament: Built-in high-explosive warhead (game: area damage on impact)
protection: Unarmoured. Game: any hit from any calibre can down it; slow and loud, so it works as a strike/map hazard that infantry can shoot down; EW can divert it.
visual_notes: Cropped delta wing with small vertical fins at the wingtips
Rear-mounted piston engine with a two-blade pusher propeller
Launched in salvoes of five from slanted box racks on truck beds
Usually unpainted grey or black (Russian Geran-2 often matt black)
